state_analysis: The analysis report was created successfully. Now I need to create the optimized_logrotate.conf file with proper rotation settings for all log files.
explanation: Now I'll create the optimized logrotate configuration file with appropriate settings for all log files.

commands.keystrokes:
cat > /app/optimized_logrotate.conf << 'EOF'
# Optimized Logrotate Configuration
# Generated: 2026-10-17
# Purpose: Address disk space issues and implement consistent log management

# Application Log - High importance, 15.2 MB/day growth
/var/log/samples/app.log {
    daily
    rotate 30
    compress
    compresscmd /bin/gzip
    compressoptions -9
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 www-data www-data
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
    maxsize 50M
    postrotate
        /usr/bin/systemctl reload web-server 2>/dev/null || true
    endscript
}

# Access Log - Medium importance, 45.7 MB/day growth (highest)
/var/log/samples/access.log {
    daily
    rotate 14
    compress
    compresscmd /bin/gzip
    compressoptions -9
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 www-data www-data
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
    maxsize 100M
    sharedscripts
    postrotate
        /usr/bin/systemctl reload nginx 2>/dev/null || true
    endscript
}

# Error Log - Critical importance, 8.9 MB/day growth
/var/log/samples/error.log {
    daily
    rotate 60
    compress
    compresscmd /bin/gzip
    compressoptions -9
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 www-data www-data
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
    maxsize 50M
    postrotate
        /usr/bin/systemctl reload web-server 2>/dev/null || true
    endscript
}

# System Log - Critical importance, 2.1 MB/day growth (low)
/var/log/samples/system.log {
    weekly
    rotate 13
    compress
    compresscmd /bin/gzip
    compressoptions -9
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 root adm
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
    maxsize 20M
}

# Debug Log - Low importance, 5.3 MB/day growth
/var/log/samples/debug.log {
    daily
    rotate 7
    compress
    compresscmd /bin/gzip
    compressoptions -9
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 www-data www-data
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
    maxsize 30M
}
EOF
